description: Upstream test isolation gap: InstallAppState::for_test sets FABRO_TEST_IN_MEMORY_STORE=1 process-wide via unsafe set_var and NEVER restores it. Any test running after an install-flow test in the same binary gets its LocalFileSystem object store silently swapped to InMemory — write_artifact_store_metadata fails NoDataInMemory{store-metadata.json}, serve::build_object_store/slatedb fail the same way. Solo passes, suite fails: env-leak signature. Also: SVG render tests (server::tests::get_graph_returns_svg +2) need target/debug/fabro built (render_graph_subprocess_exe spawns it) — cargo test alone never builds the bin; build -p fabro-cli --bin fabro first.
resolution: Pin FABRO_TEST_IN_MEMORY_STORE=0 at test start, restore/remove via Drop guard (#[expect(unsafe_code)] on Drop impl, same allowance as for_test_with_paths). For SVG tests: cargo build -p fabro-cli --bin fabro before the suite. Guards drafted on denkhaus (uncommitted) in install.rs around line 2596.

name: develop-workflow-architecture
description: Develop workflow on meta/denkhaus-lab (canonical, synced to lab via sync-check.nu): 8 nodes — planner (high), implementer (low), tester (just qualitygate), evidence (complete capture: blobref-resolve, source-before-docs), reviewer (agent node, low, tools), closeout (deterministic script: sd close + tracker check via output_schema=routing preferred_next_label). Graph: cycle_counter_reset_key=current_seed_id injects seed_cycles; STRUCTURAL guards as edge conditions (reviewer->exit kind=deadlock at seed_cycles.reviewer>=3, tester->exit at >=3, evidence re-capture bounded by seed_cycles.evidence<2) — conditions outrank unconditional edges so termination needs no model compliance. Exit kinds classify terminal events: deadlock=FailureReason::Deadlock (human decides), soft=SoftStop (re-enter). Journals: per-run JSONL (.fabro/journal/<run_id>.jsonl, run-local visits, newline-repair append). Planner never closes seeds (closeout does), never acts on approved verdicts; implementer forbidden from running the gate. ADR-0009/0010 on meta document decisions.

title: Journals are per-run JSONL streams
rationale: auto-PR merge-back must never conflict on journal files; parallel/sequential runs from one base stay independent

title: Post-approval bookkeeping is deterministic (closeout)
rationale: LLM-performed deterministic bookkeeping wastes a session per seed and mis-executes; routing on tracker state must be structural

name: develop-run-economics
description: Measured develop-run economics (first auto-merge run): total ~bash.35/seed cycle. implementer bash.109/125s (48%) — reasoning low pinned after 8.2k reasoning tokens for a resolved brief; planner@2 (pre-closeout) was bash.021/21s pure bookkeeping — removed by closeout node; reviewer bash.059 with 3.4k reasoning tokens — low pinned with revert contract. Cache discipline: 536k cache-read vs 75k input overall, but cache_write=0 everywhere (each stage repays the ~4-5k system+tools+skills prefix — fabro-944d open). ~40 skills injected per stage (~1.5k tokens each), zero activated — skill_dirs filter is upstream PR #751. Triple gate eliminated by prompt rule. Slack terminal route in project.toml (run.notifications.terminal -> #fabro-reviews, events run.completed/run.failed).

name: develop-asset-map
description: Key assets: meta/denkhaus-lab .fabro/workflows/develop/ (workflow.fabro 8 nodes/20 edges, prompts/{planner,implementer,reviewer}.md, scripts/{evidence,stage-journal,closeout,sync-check}.nu) + docs/adr/0009-0010 + CONTEXT.md vocab. Engine features on denkhaus: seed_cycles injection (cycle_counter_reset_key), dotted-path conditions, exit-kind edges (deadlock/soft -> FailureReason), HookContext.context_updates journal bridge, response dedup (compact_response_value at output.<node>), display_image for sandbox.initialized, PR-model config [run.pull_request]. Platform seeds open: fabro-67e5 (preflight PR-scope probe, in_progress), fabro-944d (cache writes), fabro-f251/176b/6a78 (upstream offering, hooks, compact-fidelity context_updates).
